verdict.rationale: Lago's docs show a plan model that combines subscription fees with usage charges, billed on separate cadences, which covers the hybrid subscription-plus-usage model. Usage charges can be edited through a no-code UI by non-engineers, and plans are assigned through the UI. One community user says it handles complex billing out of the box, but the pack never names the specific pricing models the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of tiered, volume, graduated and per-unit charge models, plus prepaid credits, minimum commitments and overage handling.
